title: Governed record-linkage project tour
description: Inspect both synthetic sources, run quality checks, and review aggregate candidate diagnostics without merging records.
prerequisite: Import the Synthetic Patient Record Linkage example project. It includes two source tables, five known truth links, and a saved command tour.

steps.title: Confirm the governed boundary
steps.instruction: The project contains two fictional eight-record sources and a five-link truth table. No comparison, classification, or merge runs automatically.

steps.title: Open the saved linkage workflow
steps.instruction: Select Open Pgm. The complete workflow is stored with the project.

steps.title: Load visible linkage source
steps.instruction: Choose recordlink-command-tour and select Open. Loading the program does not execute it.

steps.title: Verify the workflow
steps.instruction: Select Verify Program. Review the QUALITY, LIST, FREQ, TABLES, and governed EPIAI RECORDLINK commands before execution.

steps.title: Run reviewed diagnostics
steps.instruction: Select Run Commands. The current slice produces aggregate candidate diagnostics only and cannot mutate either source.

steps.title: Review candidate reduction
steps.instruction: Inspect the progressive blocking counts, reduction from the full pair space, and truth-link recall. Pair identities and patient values remain out of Output and history.

steps.title: Inspect the audit history
steps.instruction: Open History to confirm the source, plan version, status, and aggregate result summary.
